rows.text: You are on your way to eliminating the *the brain* of the domain.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: In fact, you have just parted ways with a Doctor of Chaos, the words of whom are thought-provoking: The Swarm of Propagation is just a bunch of bugs bereft any true intellect beyond their breeding instincts. Who, then, transformed them into this manner of weaponized neural network?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You look closer and notice there is an army of insects in front of you.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Drink the Doctors of Chaos medicine.

You feel so rejuvenated as though you have just slathered some cooling ointment on your forehead! But then you star seeing Device IX shifting across the sky, and start to feel unwell... It must be the fault of that Doctor of Chaos! You decide to take a detour and leave immediately.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You can feel yourself getting weak... your stomach twisting and churning! It must be the fault of that Doctor of Chaos! You decide to take a detour and leave immediately.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Enter combat and obtain 1 "Propagation" Blessing of 1- to 2-star rarity. (The Swarm's alertness will be greatly increased)
